description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineInformation" name="Machine information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StopMachine" name="Stop machine command"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OEELowEmail" name="Low OEE email"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Start OEE monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect machine information" messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEDecision" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_OEENotLow"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailEngineer" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Message_OEELowEmail"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEJoin" name="Continue OEE monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OEE" name="OEE monitoring ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEEDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEELow" name="Below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEDecision" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oee < threshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEENotLow" name="At or above threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OEEJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_EmailEngineer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Restart" sourceRef="Task_EmailEngineer" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_Join" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_OEEJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEJoin" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_MachineDisconnected" name="Handle machine disconnection" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Stop OEE process">
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TerminateEventDefinition_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Stop" sourceRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEESystem" name="OEE monitoring process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineInformation" name="Machine information" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation" messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopMachine" name="Stop machine command" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OEELowEmail" name="Low OEE email" sourceRef="Task_EmailEngineer" targetRef="Participant_Engineer" messageRef="Message_OEELowEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
